Hi lovely! Thanks for your interest in Soft Embrace pieces 🤍 

Here’s a little more info on the piece you're interested in:

Soft cũng đang lên kế hoạch để mở rộng size cho mẫu này, nếu bạn muốn mình có thể thêm bạn vào danh sách chờ cho đợt mở rộng tiếp theo ạ.
flow.en: I’m sorry — I don’t think this style would give you the comfortable fit we’d want for you in our current size range. We’re hoping to add more sizes in a future release, and we can keep you posted if you’d like 🤍
